fields.summary: Autonomous plan run (RHIZA_AUTONOMOUS=1, no owner). Research pass on runs 01M7GG7GXSA97HESRNFEBFCZ4T and 01M7GG7HSBSB356BVGGQGH8YHB. Findings: after review round 3, rhiza run review-check (internal/api/run_review.go runRunReviewCheck) adds a question per confirmed major and journals a session-less asked entry; the engine (internal/run/engine.go arbitrateAsked) has the arbiter decide it after the check step, then the plan workflow (internal/workflow/builtin/plan.toml) goes check -> gate, so the gate accepts the plan unchanged. The arbiter's Decision is written and merged (parity-seed-bridge-in-model landed with the plan in #598), but it only links answers to the question: no plan node is changed or linked decided-by to it, so the accepted plan still carries the confirmed major (a later builder applied it by hand, entry 01M7GJA0T2EJSPHZQA08QTX19H). The intent's claim of no Decision node does not hold; the unapplied ruling does. Run status prints 'decision X, not yet delivered' for these questions (internal/api/run.go markdown, Answered is set only when the engine delivers to an asking session), but a session-less question has no session to deliver to, so the line misleads. The plan-reviser guide (internal/guide/text/plan-reviser.md) covers only confirmed findings, not rulings. Planned, as the planner's own choices from this reading: a review-check --rulings check that a passed ruling is applied (a live node links decided-by to its Decision), a rulings step before the gate with an apply-rulings reviser visit, failing the run when a ruling stays unapplied; the reviser guide section; and the status line fix.
fields.title: Autonomous plan of the bug: plan-run arbiter rulings never applied
